overview.description: The thermocycler is the biggest barrier to entry for many synthetic biologists. Cheap options (e.g. miniPCR) exist, and old units from university surplus often work admirably.
objectives: use heated lids and ramp rates

instructions.title: Enter the program
instructions.description: Set initial denaturation, then the 3-step cycle (denature/anneal/extend) and final extension.

instructions.title: Use the heated lid
instructions.description: Enable the heated lid to prevent condensation/evaporation during cycling.

instructions.title: Save & reuse
instructions.description: Save common programs; note ramp rates if your enzyme is sensitive.
